title: Chapter 312 - 312 Heading To Li City; Delicious!

Chapter 312 - 312 Heading To Li City; Delicious!

Chapter 312 - 312 Heading to Li City; Delicious!

312 Heading to Li City; Delicious!

Shadowless: [1.5 billion! When can I earn a fraction of it?]

Happy Happy: [Did you notice who signed the super battery patent contract with Dahua Phone Group? It’s Lin Fan! The Lin Fan who solved Zhou’s Conjecture, the Twin Prime Number Conjecture, and Hail Conjecture!]

Golden Goldfish: [F*ck it!]

Likes Chuzheng: [F*ck!]

Loved for Life: [F*ck!]

Coming and Going: [He has solved several unsolved math problems, invented an earthquake prediction device, and now developed a super battery. He has also obtained a 1.5 billion patent license… Reality is constantly reminding me that I’m only here to make up the numbers!]

…

As for the discussions online, Lin Fan was completely ignorant.

After signing the contract with Ran Fei, the chairman of Dahua Phone Group, he drove his Mercedes-Benz to the airport.

Then, he boarded the latest flight to Li City.

It was because just now… Su Ningjing sent a message saying that some people from Magpie Coffee wanted to buy their coffee beans.

Magpie Coffee was the world’s largest coffee company.

Generally speaking, they would not do anything like forcing people to buy or sell.

However, this was under normal circumstances.

Lin Fan knew that these coffee beans were obtained from the system.

Lin Fan would not be surprised by how good their taste was.

Spirit Tea… was the best example.

If Magpie Coffee discovered the magical properties of the coffee beans, it was hard to say what they would do.

Lin Fan was afraid that Su Ningjing would not be able to handle it and was even more afraid that she would get hurt.

That was why he came to Li City personally.

Lin Fan drove the Porsche that had been parked at the airport for nearly two months and sped along the winding mountain road.

About two hours later, a short house finally appeared in his sight.

Lin Fan had just parked his car when a little girl with pigtails ran out and said happily, “Elder Brother, it’s Elder Brother! Brother is here!”

As Ah Mei finished speaking, the woman with jet-black hair and beautiful eyes that sparkled like gems stuck her head out.

It was Su Ningjing.

Today, Su Ningjing was wearing a white shirt and a plaid apron around her waist. Her already voluptuous figure looked even curvier under the contrast of her clothes.

Su Ningjing had been living in the mountain village for the past two months.

However, her skin did not show any signs of aging or coarseness.

It was because Lin Fan had given her a lot of beauty essence.

In addition, because Su Ningjing had always lived in the mountain village, her body had a unique and pure aura.

“Lin Fan, you’re here?” Su Ningjing let out a sound like the sound of spring water.

Lin Fan smiled. “Yes, I’m here.”

Su Ningjing seemed to be attracted by him. She quickly walked toward Lin Fan and threw herself into his arms.

After a while, Su Ningjing seemed to realize that Ah Mei was still beside her.

Hence, she quickly broke free from Lin Fan’s embrace and said with a red face, “Uhh… I’ve already prepared my meal. Let’s go eat first.”

“Alright,” Lin Fan replied. At the same time, he grabbed Su Ningjing’s slender hand.

Su Ningjing looked at her younger sister who was watching her from the side. She was a little shy and wanted to break free.

However, Lin Fan increased the strength of his grip.

Instantly, Su Ningjing was completely enveloped in shyness and sweetness.

At this moment, there were green pepper scrambled eggs, mushroom egg soup, small fish, and other dishes on the table.

Lin Fan sniffed the fragrance of the dishes, and the familiar scent immediately surged into his heart. This was the smell of his grandmother’s cooking when he was young. His appetite was immediately whetted.

Back then, Lin Fan had asked Su Ningjing to stay in the Coiling Dragon Villa to clean the place…

The biggest attributing factor to why she was hired was that she could replicate the taste of Lin Fan’s grandmother’s cooking.

Lin Fan did not stand on ceremony. He sat down and picked up his chopsticks to eat.

However, he quickly noticed Su Ningjing, Ah Mei, and the old lady not moving.

He immediately recalled that the custom here was for the men to eat first while the women ate the leftovers.

Lin Fan said, “Grandma, Ningjing, Sis… Didn’t we already agree the last time? Times are different now. At least when you eat with me, you don’t have to be like this.”

The old lady hesitated for a moment before nodding. “Ningjing, Ah Mei… let’s have the meal together.”

When Lin Fan heard this, he could not help but let out a smile.

He was very happy and satisfied with the meal.

Lin Fan lay on the bamboo chair and looked at the sun that was setting in the distance. He was extremely satisfied.

Suddenly, Lin Fan seemed to have thought of something and asked, “By the way, how’s the taste of the coffee beans?”

“It’s delicious!” Su Ning said. “Grandma, Ah Mei, and the villagers all said it’s delicious.”

When Su Ningjing mentioned the coffee beans, a smile appeared on her pretty face.

The beans were something that Lin Fan had left behind in the village. In her eyes, they were like her own children.

The more people liked them, the happier she was.

After a pause, Su Ningjing said, “I’ll brew you a cup right now.”

After a while, Su Ningjing walked over with a porcelain cup.

Inside… was a cup of freshly brewed coffee.

Even though Lin Fan had not drunk it yet, he was already attracted by its rich fragrance.

Under Su Ningjing’s expectant gaze, Lin Fan finally poured the coffee into his mouth.

As soon as the coffee entered his mouth, it felt like a soft ribbon had slid down his throat.

At the same time, Lin Fan seemed to hear the sound of flowing water and smell the fragrance of the grass in the forest…

Silky and sweet!

After a while, Su Ningjing could not help but ask, “How does it taste?”

Lin Fan nodded seriously. “It’s good!”

Although it was only two words, it made Su Ningjing feel as if she had eaten a candied fruit. Her heart felt sweet.

As night fell, the elderly and child had already fallen asleep.

Su Ningjing came to Lin Fan’s room and helped him lay out new sheets and blankets.

Just as Su Ningjing was about to turn around and leave, Lin Fan gently pulled her into his embrace.

After a short separation, the couple seemed like newlyweds.

…

The next day, at dawn, a rooster came to a high place with its head held high and let out a loud cry as if to prove its existence.

Lin Fan slowly opened his eyes and looked at his phone.

A text message appeared on the screen as usual.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 7,120,000 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Lin Fan muttered in his heart, ‘This time, I’m at another place. Let’s see what I can get when signing in.]

“Check in.”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 10% shares of Magpie Coffee.]
